verdict.rationale: Whether user data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud storage service like OneDrive, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or related privacy controls. The docs cover sync, sharing, versioning and Graph APIs, and the community items concern sync and default-enablement issues unrelated to AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
